text: Right, I've been up with the baby since about 2 and I'm running on empty so forgive me if this rambles. She's my partner's daughter, 4 months old. Temp was 37.8 when I took it a little while ago. When I changed her I noticed some tiny dots on her chest and a couple of darker purplish marks near her shoulder, like little bruises but she hasn't knocked herself on anything. I remembered something about the glass test so I pressed the side of a glass on them and they're still there, they didn't go pale at all. I've checked a few times now in case I was seeing things in the dim light but they're definitely not fading. Partner is on a night shift and I didn't want to panic them if it's nothing but I honestly don't know what I'm looking at.
